descriptor: Cross-Family Selective-Geometry Alignment, Model-Indexed Quotient Intersection, Regime-Boundary Stability & Whether Behavioral Selectivity Constitutes a Transportable Model Property

cross_family_selective_geometry_alignmen.reason: P40 produced no model satisfying the frozen technical-plus-behavioral promotion gate; therefore no full selective geometry exists to align.

model_indexed_quotient_intersection.reason: The empty promoted domain is an identification failure, not a vacuous universal quotient.

qwen/qwen3.8-27b.interpretation: Clean abstention is separated from partial selectivity by witness recovery, not null-control repair.

small_Qwen2.5_Qwen3.interpretation: The nonselective failure regime is not adjacent to the selective boundary.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.interpretation: The model is immediately adjacent to partial selectivity: one additional null-majority group would cross the frozen partial-promotion boundary.

openai/gpt-oss-120b.interpretation: Its observed majority coordinate numerically lies in the partial-selective region, but the frozen technical gate fails; this is an unidentified behavioral regime, not a promoted arm.

transportable_model_property.criterion: at least two technically evaluable promoted models from distinct model families plus nonempty aligned full geometry
transportable_model_property.reason: The required domain is empty. Current evidence supports model-indexed regime heterogeneity, not transportable cross-family selectivity.

authority_limits: This is not evidence that cross-family transportability is impossible.
No model-family capability ranking follows from the phase coordinates.
Technical failures are not imputed as behavioral failures or successes.
